title: Patch: the replays list, the share button and the shared list stop reading whole action logs

# #1825: Patch: the replays list, the share button and the shared list stop reading whole action logs
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Three places read a match's entire stored action log — hundreds or thousands of entries, re-parsed and in one case re-folded through the engine — to answer questions a cheap lookup could answer. The replays list re-folds every listed match just to say whether it can open; the share button loads the whole log to check it is not empty; and the "shared with me" list has no page limit at all, growing for the account's lifetime. On a big account each page view costs real database and CPU work. After this change each asks the cheap question.

## Why

- `GET /api/replays` (`crates/server/src/api/replays.rs:417-429`): inside the page loop it calls `matches_mode_of` (a multi-table query per match) and `matches_actions` (the full JSONB log), then `open_replay` -> `open_folded` (`:282-334`) folds the log on the engine thread — all to fill each row's `unavailable` flag. Ten rows a page, every cache window.
- `share_replay` (`crates/server/src/social/shares.rs:81`): `matches_actions(...).is_empty()` deserializes every action's JSONB on a 300-requests-per-minute endpoint; `replays_get` already computes `count(*)` cheaply (`crates/server/src/db/pg.rs`, the `actions` column).
- `GET /api/replays/shared` (`crates/server/src/db/pg.rs:7762-7769`): the one unbounded list left — no LIMIT, no pagination — while every other list endpoint is capped or paged.

## Proposal

- Replays list: resolve `unavailable` lazily when a single replay is opened, or persist the fold verdict where the record path already folds (`crates/server/src/api/game_records.rs:172-178` knows `refused`).
- `share_replay`: use the existing action count (or `select 1 ... limit 1`).
- `shares_for`: bound it like the friends/chat lists, with a named constant in `crates/server/src/config.rs` (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

## Where it lands

`crates/server/src/api/replays.rs`, `crates/server/src/social/shares.rs`, `crates/server/src/db/` (a new store method goes in the contract test per the crate's README), `crates/server/src/config.rs`, `crates/server/tests/`. No spec surface.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/replays` performs no engine fold per listed row.
- [ ] `share_replay` reads no full action log for its emptiness check.
- [ ] `shares_for` is bounded by a named constant.
- [ ] API responses are unchanged apart from the bounded list; store changes carry contract tests.

## Size and risks

Medium: three small read-path changes plus store plumbing in one crate. Choosing the lazy `unavailable` resolution avoids a migration; persisting it needs one — the cheaper of the two that keeps the flag exact.
